units.source_text: 《述异记》所载：“晋王质入山樵采，见二童子对弈，童子与质一物如枣核，食之不饥。

en.t: The Record of Strange Tales says: Wang Zhi of Jin went into the mountains to gather firewood and saw two boys playing go. One of the boys gave Zhi something like a date pit; after eating it, he did not feel hungry.

units.source_text: 局终，童子指示曰：‘汝柯烂矣。’

en.t: When the game ended, the boy pointed it out and said, 'Your axe handle has rotted away.'
When Zhi returned to his home village, a hundred years had already passed.'
People came to call this mountain 'Rotten Handle Mountain.'
Ke means the handle of an axe.
